columns.name: show_date
columns.description: Night the show played. Settlements are prepared after this date.

columns.name: billing
columns.description: Full billing line used on the settlement memo.

columns.name: deal_type
columns.description: FLAT pays the guarantee. PERCENTAGE pays a share of the pool. VS pays the greater of the two.

columns.name: guarantee_cents
columns.description: Guaranteed fee in cents. Zero for a pure percentage deal.

columns.name: percentage_bps
columns.description: Artist share in basis points. 7000 is 70.00 percent.

columns.name: expense_cap_cents
columns.description: Most recoupable expense the deal allows, in cents.

columns.name: external_ref
columns.description: Stable id from the venue's show book.
